title: Astro Quest: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
description: Command a Moon outpost! Share out solar power, keep your crew breathing and fed, and make 10-second decisions during real NASA-recorded solar storms. A NASA Space Apps Cairo 2026 game for ages 7-13.

defaultCaptions.x: I just ran a Moon base in Astro Quest and survived real NASA solar storms! Can you keep your crew safe?
defaultCaptions.facebook: Astro Quest: a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer made for NASA Space Apps Cairo 2026. Run a lunar outpost, balance air, food, power and radiation shielding, and face real solar flares from NASA's DONKI database.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Astro Quest - a kids' lunar outpost survival sim built on real NASA space-weather data (NASA Space Apps Cairo 2026)
